description.zh: 应用配置。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~1000。
description.en: The application configurations. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 1000.

description.zh: 应用列表。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The list of applications. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

description.zh: 引导脚本数组。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The array of bootstrap scripts. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 10.

description.zh: 幂等客户端TOKEN。同一个ClientToken多次调用的返回结果一致，同一个ClientToken最多只创建一个集群。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Multiple calls with the same client token return the same result and create only one cluster.

description.zh: 集群名称。长度为1~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The cluster name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

description.zh:
集群类型。取值范围：
- DATALAKE：新版数据湖。
- OLAP：数据分析。
- DATAFLOW：实时数据流。
- DATASERVING：数据服务。
- CUSTOM：自定义混部集群。
- HADOOP：旧版数据湖（不推荐使用，建议使用新版数据湖）。

如果您在2022年12月19日17点（UTC+8）以后第一次创建EMR集群，不能选择HADOOP、DATA_SCIENCE、PRESTO、ZOOKEEPER集群类型。
description.en:
The cluster type. Valid values:

- DATALAKE: new data lake.

- OLAP: data analytics.

- DATAFLOW: real-time data stream.

- DATASERVING: DataService Studio.

- CUSTOM: custom cluster.

- HADOOP: legacy data lake. This value is not recommended. Use the new data lake cluster type instead.

If you create an EMR cluster for the first time after 17:00 (UTC+8) on December 19, 2022, you cannot select HADOOP, DATA\_SCIENCE, PRESTO, or ZOOKEEPER as the cluster type.

description.zh:
集群是否开启删除保护。取值范围：
- true：开启删除保护。
- false：不开启删除保护。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the cluster. Valid values:

- true: Enables deletion protection.

- false: Disables deletion protection.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
集群中的应用部署模式。取值范围：
- NORMAL（默认值）：非高可用部署。集群1个MASTER节点。
- HA：高可用部署。高可用部署要求至少3个MASTER节点。
description.en:
The deployment mode of applications in the cluster. Valid values:

- NORMAL (default): non-high availability deployment. The cluster has one master node.

- HA: high availability (HA) deployment. This deployment mode requires at least three master nodes.

description.zh: 节点属性。集群所有ECS节点基础属性。
description.en: The node attributes. These are the basic attributes of all ECS nodes in the cluster.

description.zh: 节点组配置数组。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The array of node group configurations. The number of array elements N can range from 1 to 100.

description.zh:
付费类型。取值范围：
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
- Subscription：预付费。

默认值：PayAsYouGo。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

- Subscription: subscription.

Default value: PayAsYouGo.

description.zh: EMR发行版。可通过EMR集群售卖页面查看EMR发行版。
description.en: The EMR release version. You can find the EMR release version on the EMR cluster purchase page.

description.zh:
集群Kerberos安全模式。取值范围：
- NORMAL（默认值）：普通模式，不开启Kerberos模式。
- KERBEROS：开启Kerberos模式。
description.en:
The Kerberos security mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- NORMAL (default): normal mode. Kerberos is disabled.

- KERBEROS: Kerberos mode. Kerberos is enabled.

description.zh: 预付费配置。当PaymentType取值为Subscription时必填。
description.en: The subscription configurations. This parameter is required if you set PaymentType to Subscription.

description.zh: 标签。数组元数个数N的取值范围：0~20。
description.en: The tags. The number of array elements N can range from 0 to 20.

descriptions.zh: RunCluster 是 CreateCluster 的升级版本，采用 HTTPS POST 请求，支持更长的参数内容。对于复杂参数，如对象和数组，RunCluster 采用 JSON 格式，使其对 CLI 工具更加友好。
descriptions.en: RunCluster is an upgraded version of CreateCluster. It uses HTTPS POST requests and supports larger parameter values. For complex parameters, such as objects and arrays, RunCluster uses the JSON format. This improves compatibility with command-line interface (CLI) tools.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr run-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzabjyop0000 --payment-type PayAsYouGo --subscription-config example-string --cluster-type DATALAKE --release-version EMR-5.16.0 --cluster-name emrtest --deploy-mode HA --security-mode NORMAL --applications example-string --application-configs example-string --node-attributes example-string --node-groups '["example-string"]' --bootstrap-scripts '["example-string"]' --tags example-string --client-token A7D960FA-6DBA-5E07-8746-A63E3E4D0000 --description Emr_cluster_for_ETL --deletion-protection false --promotions example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr RunCluster --region cn-hangzhou --Description Emr_cluster_for_ETL --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzabjyop0000' --Applications '["example-string"]' --Promotions '["example-string"]' --ApplicationConfigs '["example-string"]' --ClusterType DATALAKE --DeletionProtection false --NodeGroups '["example-string"]' --ReleaseVersion 'EMR-5.16.0' --BootstrapScripts '["example-string"]' --SubscriptionConfig 'example-string' --DeployMode HA --SecurityMode NORMAL --NodeAttributes 'example-string' --PaymentType PayAsYouGo --ClusterName emrtest --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 'A7D960FA-6DBA-5E07-8746-A63E3E4D0000' --Tags '["example-string"]'
